notes.title: End of Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Gliding Knight Games would like to thank everyone who played the demo of Top Check during the Steam Next Fest.  It's been a blast to hear your feedback and it's awesome to hear how many people enjoyed the game.

Moving forward, for now we'd like to prioritize addressing your feedback and continue improving the game.  As such we will be taking the demo down, but hope to bring it back up in the not too distant future.  When it returns, you can expect more content, features, and polish.  In the meantime, be sure to join our Discord to stay up-to-date with future updates.

Thanks again for all your support!
- Gliding Knight Games
